description:
Decode the type-hierarchy kind and the label-uniqueness scope of rules into enums at load.

## Background

`TypeHierarchyKind` (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:1420`) is matched by a hand-written token table when rules serialize (`repository_state/rule_serialize.rs:291`), and the label-uniqueness scope is read as a string.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `TypeHierarchyKind` and the label-uniqueness scope are declared through the macro and decoded at load.
- [hard] REQ-02: The token match in rule serialization is gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: A malformed value fails rule loading with an error naming the rule.
title: Type-hierarchy and label-uniqueness rule options are typed
